api/chat.mjs.name: Chat endpoint
api/chat.mjs.description: Receives a question from the web app when the app runs on Vercel and passes it on to the chat logic.

api/health.mjs.name: Health check
api/health.mjs.description: A simple yes/no answer that tells monitoring tools the service is up.

src/app/api/chat/route.ts.name: Chat endpoint
src/app/api/chat/route.ts.description: Receives a question from the chat page, asks the agent for an answer, and sends back the text with its sources.

src/app/api/documents/[id]/route.ts.name: Download a vacancy document
src/app/api/documents/[id]/route.ts.description: Lets a person download a vacancy draft they asked the agent to write, as a Word file.

src/app/api/overview/route.ts.name: Company overview
src/app/api/overview/route.ts.description: Gives the side panel next to the chat the company figures the agent uses, so the two always agree.

POST /api/chat.name: Send a question
POST /api/chat.description: Sends a question to the agent and gets back the answer and its sources.

GET /api/documents/[id].name: Download a vacancy draft
GET /api/documents/[id].description: Gives back a vacancy draft the agent wrote, as a Word file.

GET /api/overview.name: Company overview figures
GET /api/overview.description: Gives back the key company figures shown next to the chat.
